---
title: "01 - Build the per-gene population genetics + annotation tables"
output: html_document
date: "2025-06-19"
---

This notebook turns the InStrain output for every MAG / read-depth combination into
one table per site with per-gene population genetic statistics (πN/πS, θN/θS, pN/pS)
joined to functional annotations (UniRef90, PHROGs), BUSCO membership and MAG lifestyle.

Outputs (written to `data/intermediate/`, these are the inputs of `03_figures_selection.Rmd`):

* `MAG_popgen_plus_anno_M5.tsv.gz`, `MAG_popgen_plus_anno_M1.tsv.gz`
* `MAG_table_2.tsv` (MAG quality / taxonomy table)

Side outputs go to `results/tables/`.

**Note:** pre-computed copies of all outputs are already shipped in `data/intermediate/`,
so you only need to run this notebook if you want to regenerate them. It needs the raw
MMseqs2 UniRef90 hit tables (`data/annotations/uniref_hits_M5_3.tsv` and
`uniref_hits_M1_3.tsv`), which are produced by the `mmseqs_uniref` rule in
`pipeline/Snakefile` and are not included in this repository.

Naming conventions used throughout:

* `M1` / `M5` – sampling site
* `M5_3` – MAG set assembled from site M5 at 3 cm below sea floor (cmbsf)
* `reads_source` – the depth (cmbsf) the *reads* were taken from. "depth" always means
  sediment depth, never depth of coverage (that is called "coverage").

```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(here) # here() builds paths from the project root, wherever the project is unpacked

data_dir <- here("data")
table_dir <- here("results", "tables")
dir.create(table_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Fail early, with a useful message, if an input that is not shipped is missing
required_inputs <- file.path(data_dir, c(
  "annotations/uniref_hits_M5_3.tsv",
  "annotations/uniref_hits_M1_3.tsv"
))
missing_inputs <- required_inputs[!file.exists(required_inputs)]
if (length(missing_inputs) > 0) {
  stop("Missing input file(s):\n  ", paste(missing_inputs, collapse = "\n  "),
       "\nThese are produced by the `mmseqs_uniref` rule in pipeline/Snakefile (see README.md).")
}
```

## Per-gene πN/πS, θN/θS and pN/pS — site M5

`raw_genes_filtered_w_theta_hat_*` is the InStrain gene_info output for every read depth,
with the number of synonymous (`Ls`) and non-synonymous (`Ln`) sites of every gene added.
Here we go back to the per-SNV InStrain output to compute the per-gene statistics.

```{r}
rgwt_m5 <- read_delim(file.path(data_dir, "intermediate/raw_genes_filtered_w_theta_hat_M5_3.tsv.gz"))
all_depths_pi_n_pi_s_M5 = data.frame(data.frame(matrix(ncol = 21, nrow = 0)))
colnames(all_depths_pi_n_pi_s_M5) <- c("gene","MAG","start","reads_source","gene_length","Ls","Ln","coverage","sites_N","sites_S","n_variants_N","n_variants_S","pi_N","pi_S","theta_N","theta_S","pi_NS","theta_NS","p_N","p_S","p_NS")

# one iteration per read depth (cmbsf); 5 cm is not used for M5
for( i in c(1, 3, 7, 10, 25)){
  temp_snvs <- read_delim(file.path(data_dir, paste0("all_depths_M5_3/IS_raw_M5_3_",i,"_SNVs.tsv.gz")))

  # attach gene length, Ls/Ln and coverage to every SNV
  temp_snvs <- left_join(temp_snvs, rgwt_m5  %>% filter(reads_source == i) %>% select(gene,MAG,start, gene_length, Ls, Ln, coverage) )

  # nucleotide diversity at each SNV position: 1 - sum(allele frequency^2)
  temp_snvs <- temp_snvs %>%
    mutate(
      position_pi =  1 - ((A / position_coverage)**2 + (C / position_coverage)**2 + (T / position_coverage)**2 + (G / position_coverage)**2)
    )
  # summarise per gene, separately for non-synonymous (N) and synonymous (S) SNVs
  temp_genes_plus_p_pi <- temp_snvs %>%
    group_by(gene,MAG,start, mutation_type, gene_length, Ls, Ln, coverage) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_SNV_pi = mean(position_pi),
      sites = n(),
      n_variants = sum(allele_count) - n() # allele_count = 2 -> reference + variant
    ) %>% filter((mutation_type == "N") | (mutation_type == "S")) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      id_cols = c(gene, start, MAG, gene_length, Ls, Ln, coverage),
      names_from=mutation_type,
      values_from = c(mean_SNV_pi, sites, n_variants)
      )
  # normalise by the number of N / S sites in the gene.
  # theta-hat is Watterson's estimator with ln(coverage) standing in for the harmonic number
  temp_genes_plus_pi <- temp_genes_plus_p_pi %>%
    mutate(
      pi_N = (mean_SNV_pi_N / Ln),
      pi_S = (mean_SNV_pi_S / Ls),
      theta_N = (sites_N / (Ln * log(coverage))),
      theta_S = (sites_S / (Ls * log(coverage))),
      p_N = (n_variants_N / Ln),
      p_S = (n_variants_S / Ls)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      pi_NS = pi_N / pi_S,
      theta_NS = theta_N / theta_S,
      p_NS = p_N / p_S #hahaha
    ) %>% select(-mean_SNV_pi_N, -mean_SNV_pi_S) %>% #intermediary values not needed in final
    mutate(reads_source = i)
  all_depths_pi_n_pi_s_M5 <- rbind(all_depths_pi_n_pi_s_M5, temp_genes_plus_pi)
}
all_depths_pi_n_pi_s_M5 %>% write_delim(file.path(table_dir, "pop_gen_gene_stats_M5_3.tsv"),delim="\t")

```

## Functional annotation — site M5

UniRef90 hits come from `mmseqs easy-search` (BLAST tab format, no header). Only the first
(best) hit per gene is kept. The list of UniRef IDs written out here was uploaded to the
UniProt ID-mapping service to get `uniref_annotations_M5_3.tsv.gz`.

```{r}
cnames = c("gene","From", "pident","length","mismatch","gapopen","qstart","qend","sstart","send","evalue","bitscore")
uniref_hits <- read_delim(file.path(data_dir, "annotations/uniref_hits_M5_3.tsv"),delim="\t",col_names = cnames) %>% group_by(gene) %>% slice_head(n=1) %>% ungroup()
uniref_hits %>% select(From) %>% write_delim(file.path(table_dir, "uniref_hits_filtered_ids_M5_3.txt"),delim="\t")

uniref_ids <- read_delim(file.path(data_dir, "annotations/uniref_annotations_M5_3.tsv.gz"))
gene_annotations_M5 <- left_join(uniref_hits %>% select(gene, From, pident), uniref_ids)
```

PHROGs is a phage-specific protein database; keep the lowest e-value hit per gene.

```{r}
phrog_hits <- read_delim(file.path(data_dir, "annotations/phrog_hits_M5_3.tsv.gz"),col_names = cnames) %>% rename(key = From) #phrog is a phage specific db
phrog_anno <- read_delim(file.path(data_dir, "annotations/phrog_table.tsv.gz"))
phrogs <- left_join(phrog_hits %>% select(gene, key, pident, evalue), phrog_anno) %>% select(-key, -Location) %>% filter(!is.na(Entry))
phrogs %>% write_delim(file.path(table_dir, "phrog_annotations_M5_3.tsv"),delim="\t")
phrog_best <- phrogs %>% rename(protein = `Protein names`, Phrog = Entry, phrog_pident = pident, phrog_eval = evalue, phrog_Accession = Accesssion ) %>% group_by(gene) %>%  slice_min(phrog_eval, n = 1, with_ties = F) %>% ungroup()
```

Length distribution of the UniRef90 hits (in nt); the red lines mark the 500–2000 nt window
used below for genes without a UniRef hit.

```{r}
gene_annotations_M5 %>% ggplot(aes(x=(Length*3))) + geom_histogram() + xlim(0,5000) + geom_vline(xintercept=500, linetype="dashed", color="red") + geom_vline(xintercept=2000, linetype="dashed", color="red")
```
```{r}
popstat_all_anno_M5 <- left_join(left_join(all_depths_pi_n_pi_s_M5, gene_annotations_M5), phrog_best, by = join_by(gene), suffix = c("_uniref","_phrog"))
head(popstat_all_anno_M5)
```

How many genes does the length filter keep? (all genes / genes within ±25 % of their UniRef
hit length / the same plus un-annotated genes of 500–2000 nt)

```{r}
length((popstat_all_anno_M5 %>% group_by(gene) %>% slice_head(n=1) %>% ungroup())$gene)
```

```{r}
length((popstat_all_anno_M5 %>% group_by(gene) %>% slice_head(n=1) %>% ungroup() %>% filter(((gene_length  >= (Length * 3 * 0.75)) & (gene_length <= (Length * 3 * 1.25)))))$gene)
```


```{r}
length((popstat_all_anno_M5 %>% group_by(gene) %>% slice_head(n=1) %>% ungroup() %>% filter(((gene_length  >= (Length * 3 * 0.75)) & (gene_length <= (Length * 3 * 1.25))) | (is.na(Length) & ((gene_length > 500) & (gene_length < 2000)))))$gene)
```

Keep genes whose predicted length is within ±25 % of their UniRef hit or, if they have no
hit, that are 500–2000 nt long. This removes truncated / fused gene predictions.

```{r}
popstat_all_anno_filtered_M5 <- popstat_all_anno_M5 %>% filter(((gene_length  >= (Length * 3 * 0.75)) & (gene_length <= (Length * 3 * 1.25))) | (is.na(Length) & ((gene_length > 500) & (gene_length < 2000))))
```

MAG lifestyle (surface specialist / generalist / subsurface specialist) and a short phylogeny label.

```{r}
lifestyle_plus_phylo_m5 <- read_delim(file.path(data_dir, "mags/lifestyles_M5_3.tsv")) %>% mutate(MAG = paste0(genome, ".filtered.fa"))
```

Flag BUSCO (single-copy core) genes and write the final M5 table.

```{r}
busco_gene_ids_M5 <- read_delim(file.path(data_dir, "annotations/busco_gene_ids_M5_3.txt"),delim=",")
popstat_all_anno_filtered_M5 <- popstat_all_anno_filtered_M5 %>% mutate(is_busco = gene %in% busco_gene_ids_M5$gene)
left_join(popstat_all_anno_filtered_M5,lifestyle_plus_phylo_m5)  %>% group_by(gene, reads_source) %>% slice_head(n=1) %>% ungroup() %>% write_delim(file.path(data_dir, "intermediate/MAG_popgen_plus_anno_M5.tsv.gz"),delim="\t")
```

## Neutral range of θN/θS (bootstrap)

The "Purifying" / "Neutral" / "Positive" cut-offs used in `03_figures_selection.Rmd` come
from this section. For genes with θN/θS close to 1, the SNV counts are resampled (Poisson)
1000 times to see how much θN/θS varies from sampling noise alone; the neutral range is
then mean ± 3 SD.

```{r}
# returns c(mean, sd) of the bootstrapped theta_N / theta_S for one gene
bootstrap_gene <- function(snv_s_count, snv_n_count, ln, ls, covg){
  nrep_ = 1000
  pns = rep(NA, nrep_)
  for(i in seq(1:(1+nrep_))){
    s = rpois(1, snv_s_count)
    n = rpois(1, snv_n_count)
    p_n = n / (ln * log(covg))
    p_s = s / (ls * log(covg))
    pnps = p_n / p_s
    pns[i] = pnps
  }
  return(c(mean(pns), sd(pns)))
}
bootstrap_gene_v <- Vectorize(bootstrap_gene)
```
```{r}
output <- popstat_all_anno_filtered_M5 %>% filter((theta_NS >= 0.9) & (theta_NS <= 1.1)) %>% rowwise() %>% mutate(bs_mean = bootstrap_gene(sites_S, sites_N, Ln, Ls, coverage)[1], bs_std = bootstrap_gene(sites_S, sites_N, Ln, Ls, coverage)[2]) %>% ungroup()
```
```{r}
output %>% ungroup() %>% filter(!is.infinite(bs_mean)) %>% summarise(mean_of_means = mean(bs_mean, na.rm=T), sd(bs_mean,na.rm=T))
```

Upper and lower limits of the neutral range (mean ± 3 SD). The numbers are copied from the
output above, which changes slightly from run to run because the bootstrap is random.

```{r}
1.114 + 3*0.0894
```
```{r}

```

```

```

## MAG summary table

Combine taxonomy/BUSCO (`MAG_table_further_analysis.tsv`) with CheckM2 quality statistics
and keep only the MAGs that made it into the gene tables above.

```{r}
mag_table <- read_delim(file.path(data_dir, "mags/MAG_table_further_analysis.tsv")) #this didn't have CheckM2 data for M1_3 so I add that in in subsq. steps
head(mag_table)

```
```{r}
check_m2_m5_3 <- read_delim(file.path(data_dir, "mags/checkm2_quality_report_M5_3.tsv"))
head(check_m2_m5_3)
```
```{r}
check_m2_m1_3 <- read_delim(file.path(data_dir, "mags/checkm2_quality_report_M1_3.tsv"))
check_m2 <- rbind(check_m2_m5_3, check_m2_m1_3) %>% mutate(MAG = paste0(Name, ".fa")) %>% select(-Name)
```



```{r}
mag_table2 <- left_join(
    mag_table %>%
    mutate(`Site + Depth` = paste0(Site, " ",`Assembly Depth`)) %>%
    select(
      MAG, Domain, Phylum, Class, Order, Family, Genus, Species, `Site + Depth`,
      `BUSCO Completeness`, Duplications,
      )
    , check_m2 %>% select(MAG, Completeness, Contamination, Genome_Size, Total_Contigs, Max_Contig_Length, Contig_N50, GC_Content)
  ) %>%
  rename(
      `BUSCO Contamination` = Duplications,
      `CheckM2 Completeness`= Completeness,
      `CheckM2 Contamination`= Contamination,
      `Genome size` = Genome_Size,
      `Total Contigs` = Total_Contigs,
      `Max contig length` = Max_Contig_Length,
      N50 = Contig_N50
      ) %>%
  mutate(`GC %` = GC_Content * 100) %>%
  select(-GC_Content) %>%
  # human readable sizes (Mb / Kb)
  mutate(`Genome size` = ifelse(`Genome size` > 1E6, paste0(round(`Genome size`/1E6, digits=2),"Mb"),paste0(round(`Genome size`/1000),"Kb"))) %>%
  mutate(`Max contig length` = paste0(`Max contig length` = round(`Max contig length`/1000),"Kb")) %>%
  mutate(N50 = paste0(N50 = round(N50 / 1000),"Kb")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(MAG)) %>%
  # keep only MAGs that are in the gene tables (M1 MAG names carry a refs/ prefix there)
  filter((paste0("refs/",MAG) %in% popstat_all_anno_M1_filtered$MAG) | (MAG %in% popstat_all_anno_filtered_M5$MAG))
mag_table2 %>%
  write_delim(file.path(data_dir, "intermediate/MAG_table_2.tsv"),delim="\t")

```
